Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['Thank you, Dr. Sobeck. You can take a seat.', 'Dr. Sobeck has made the situation very clear, General - and given us an option. We should all be thanking her.', "There's not going to be any discussion. You saw the numbers. Now Faro, he'll foot the bill, but his money can't buy the time necessary to complete Zero Dawn. That... can only be paid for in blood.", "Commanders! The enemy we're facing self-replicates faster than we can kill it, and it eats biomass as fuel! Zero Dawn is all we've got.", "By giving them something to fight for. Zero Dawn. The top-secret super-weapons program that will save us - so long as humanity holds off the swarm long enough for Dr. Sobeck and her team to finish it. The file I'm sending contains the war plan for Operation: Enduring Victory.", "It may be ugly - but it's something. Consider the alternative. Dr. Sobeck. I've secured use of a decommissioned Orbital Launch Base outside Bryce, Utah as the Zero Dawn staging area. Plenty of space there. When can you get started?", "Leave that to me. You'll get your dream team. Count on it.", "Welcome to Project: Zero Dawn. I'm General Herres, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff of the United States of America. I'm sure you've heard the rumors. That Zero Dawn is a top-secret superweapons program. The technological miracle that will save us from the Faro Plague - if Operation: Enduring Victory can hold off the robots long enough. The reason I'm sure you've heard the rumors is that I'm the one who spread them. And they are all lies. Zero Dawn is not a superweapons program and I will not save us. Nothing will save us, and here's why. By the time the Glitch was noticed, it was already too late. Nothing could stop the Faro Plague. Nothing can. Its robots will continue to replicate and devour the biosphere. Life on Earth will be destroyed... our planet reduced to a barren sphere. Global extinction is inevitable. No matter how many we kill, the robots just keep exponentially making more. If we had their deactivation codes, we could shut them all down. The entire swarm. But since their cryptographic protocols use poly-phasic entangled waveforms, cracking a code set would take half a century. At best, we've got 16 months. Not exactly what you'd call a survival option. The destruction of a biosphere is not the sort of apocalypse you can wait out in a fallout shelter or space station. There will be no Earth left to reclaim. Just a lifeless, toxic rock with several million Faro robots on it... hibernating, waiting for something to eat. This is the horrible truth behind the lies of Operation: Enduring Victory - my lies - lies designed to inspire millions of innocents to sacrifice themselves in battle. Why? One reason: to buy time for you and the work you will do here. Zero Day - the day that life on Earth ceases to exist - is coming fast. It cannot be stopped. The hope of Zero Dawn is that something new might come after. But I will leave it to Elisabet Sobeck to shine that thin ray of light into the darkness, Herres out.", "Dr. Sobeck, please archive this testimonial in APOLLO, cross-referenced to all mentions of my name and Operation: Enduring Victory. My name is General Aaron Herres. From 2060 to 2066. I served as the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the highest-ranked officer of the United States Armed Forces. The tenure of my command included strategic planning and oversight of Operation: Enduring Victory, a falsehood perpetrated on the civilian populations of the United States and other nations during the last 14 months of life on this planet. Before the Faro Plague, I did my job and did it well. I was bold and decisive, crafty in political maneuvers. It wasn't an accident that I rose to my position and became the commander of the largest mechanized force ever assembled. But to what end? My only lasting achievement was the extinction of life on Earth. And my one redeeming act - if any - was to delay that extinction by days or week by throwing more death at it. It is my hope that there will be no need for men like me in the world to come. If you are one of the péople of that future world, listening to this message please know that I am sorry, and that I wish you well. Sincerely, General Aaron Herres."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["By the Sun! King Avad's edict really is taking effect. Never thought I'd see a Nora here. So, you have marks for me?", "From the Hunting Grounds? Oh, right. You're new here.", "King Avad insisted that the Hunters Lodge had to welcome everyone -- man, woman, outlander -- regardless of tribe. Ersa, Captain of the Vanguard, came in and delivered that news personally. You should've been there. It was glorious. But I figured they would sweep it under the rug and say no woman or outlander qualified. Yet here you are.", "Me? No. Carja don't exactly encourage their daughters to run around hunting machines. But all these changes have been good for me. I don't think the Oseram know how to sell us to us Carja. The trader I worked for last couldn't sell flowers to a bee. He was too plain-hammered, as they like to say. This is a much better job, I figure I'll be able to open my own shop soon enough.", "You hunters and your badges. I'm not going to take them. I'm going to give you a weapon that sets you apart. Yeah, I thought that'd get your attention. If you earn marks in all three Trials at each of the five hunting grounds, come to me. I can give you up to three weapons, one for fifteen Half Suns, one for fifteen Full Suns, and one you'll love for all Blazing Suns.", "If you get the same mark from all the Hunting Ground Trials, I can give you a Hunters Lodge weapon. Show me what marks you've earned, and we'll see if you qualify for one of these special weapons I have for you.", "No problem. Once you have marks from all fifteen trials, you'll be able to get the next Hunters Lodge weapon from me."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Rost! Down here! Rost! ROST! He won't hear me. Some kind of cave?", "Ew. Rats. Looks tight. But I can get through... This must be a ruin of the Metal World! One of the old places... Rost said never go in places like this... but I have to find a way out. There's something up ahead... What's that? A dead person! There's something shiny there.", "Lights - everywhere! How does it do this? A metal door. Closed. Maybe this device I found can help? How do I get it open? More lights... A shape. It's connected to the door somehow.", 'It changed color! The door changed color, too!', "It did it! What's that? It's got a device, like the one I found.", 'Show me... Show me again!', 'Hi.', 'Happy Birthday, Isaac... Daddy sure does love his little big man.', 'Why did they die here? What happened to them?', 'He found me! Rost found me!', 'I fell in.', 'Nothing. No.', 'No!', 'No!', 'All these shapes. What do they mean?', 'I know.', 'Bleh.', 'Where are we?', 'Embrace?', 'Are they dangerous?', 'Little ones!', "Who's that?", "But why is he up there? He's smiling at us.", "Maybe he doesn't like the tribe.", "Why'd you chase them off?", 'Why?', "But rocks can't hurt machines... right?", 'Warn them? How?', 'The canister on its back -- is that a weakness?', 'The device, it showed me!', 'That boy! The one running the brave trails!', 'But I can see the paths they take!', "I'm not! I can sneak through.", "I need to move slowly and quietly, so I can sneak past them. Can't let them see me... Got to be careful... I need to see their paths... Almost there... There he is... ", 'Hey!', 'Shhh! Follow me!', 'I know the way.', 'Seal your lips, boy... seal your lips.', 'Ahh!', 'Why?', 'Why am I an outcast?', 'Who was my mother?', 'So the Matriarchs, they know?', 'But they know?', 'So how do I make them tell me?', 'So, tell me.', 'How!?', "I don't care. How do I do it? Tell me!", 'A boon?', "Then I'll do it. Whatever it takes. I'll win the Proving.", 'Start training? Yes, follow.', "Rost... Rost!... Rooost!!! Where is he? Two days before the Proving, and he goes off without me? He wouldn't do that.", "I'll do what I have to. Where's he go to?", "He's just... standing there. What's going on with him?", 'Did you want to be alone?', "Of course. I'll always learn what you have to teach.", 'Fire Arrows? What kind of trouble are we talking about?', 'The North Gate? At the edge of the Embrace?', 'Is something else bothering you?', 'Are you worrying about what happens... after the Proving?', "... Okay. I'll go gather the parts. But I'm also going to pay Karst a visit.", "And I'm glad he does. I want to buy a Tripcaster, and no other trader will sell to outcasts.", 'That sounds ominous. All right, see you at the North Gate.', "Somethings really bothering him. If he thinks I'm gonna abandon him, he's wrong.", "The Embrace. My whole life, I've never gone beyond this valley. That'll change after the Proving. Two days. Two days until I get answers. Two days, and I'll know who she was. And why I was cast out at birth. As if there could be an excuse for that. All right, time to gather the Parts for some Fire Arrows. I should find a herd.", "Lucky they don't talk to me. Don't think I'd be very nice.", "Time to see Karst and get a Tripcaster. No one else around. Looks safe to meet. My guess is, he'll be waiting for me. There he is. Looks nervous.", "Surprised you saw me, the way you keep looking every other direction to make sure no one's watching. Careful there, or you'll sprain your neck.", 'Humph. Last time I visited, you had a Tripcaster available for trade. Still got it?', 'Oh. I can pay. Took down a Scrapper not long ago, stripped out the lens in perfect condition.', 'Really? Could have fooled me.', 'Will you be around later, in case I want to make another trade?', 'Is there a reason why you re acting so cranky today?', "Traders who don't break the law and deal with outcasts, you mean?", "Are you worried I'm going to tell someone that you trade with outcasts?", 'You can stop worrying. The secrets safe with me.', 'Why do you take the risk, trading with outcasts?', "It's because you used to be one, isn't it?", 'What did you see in the Ruins?', "The only person I've ever told about our trades is Rost.", "You really don't know why he was cast out?", 'I guess that concludes our business.', "I've got what I need. Time to meet Rost at the North Gate.", "Whatever they're hunting out there, it doesn't sound easy.", "There he is, right where he said he'd be. Always is.", 'I do. Those explosions and shouts beyond the Embrace - is that the trouble you were talking about?', "Wait for dark? Look, Rost, I've thought it through and I'm not going to shun you after the Proving, okay? I'm just... I won't do it. I'm not about to pretend that you never raised me.", "It does, and I don't care. I know what duty means for you, Rost, but all tribal law has ever done for me is take things away. And that's not going to happen again.", "And so you will. I knew you'd say that, so... this is what we'll do. I will come to you in secret. No one will see me, so I won't get in trouble. And I know you won't talk to me because... it's against the law. But I'll talk to you. It'll be my crime, not yours. You'll just... listen. And that's how we'll handle this.", "I know, right? So you can stop worrying. It's handled.", "I don't understand. Those explosions are outside the Embrace. What can we do from in here?", 'I saw Karst and got that Tripcaster I was talking about.', "It wasn't cheap, but the Tripcaster is worth it.", "Still a while to go before dark. I guess I'll get some rest.", 'Opening a gate for an outcast?', 'So much for tribal law.', 'That carcass! What sort of beast was that?', 'Yeah.', 'That cabin. What happened to it?', 'What sort of machine does that?', "Oh... I see. A Watcher carcass. I'll harvest the Parts.", "Why are we the only ones out here tonight? Why can't the tribe's braves hunt this machine?", "They won't need to. This machine will be my kill.", 'An entire lodge, wrecked?! By Sawtooths? How many were there?', "It's huge. How do you defeat it?", "I should stay out of sight. I can use the tall grass to approach... Let's see... where can I place my traps? That wasn't a warning. It saw me! I should scan it, see what that reveals.", 'Not to answer questions.', 'Survival requires perfection. It was a test, to hone my skills against a dangerous new machine.', "My tribe?! You said I wouldn't need them.", 'I understand the final lesson, Rost.', "But if I'm going to stand for something, it'll have to be something I believe in.", "I'll see you at Mo h rs Heart, then.", "Yes. I guess. It's... louder than I expected.", "I guess everything's bigger up close.", "I don't know about that.", "What should I expect once I'm inside?", "Are you sure they're going to let me in?", '"And any who pass are made braves, and are outcasts no more." I know that. But not everyone follows the law like you do, Rost.', 'Any final lessons before I head in?', 'It was you who taught me, not the wilds. Not sure my bow and spear will be much help in there, though.', "I'm ready to do this. See you back home in a few days?", "Why are you talking like we'll never see each other again? No... No... ", "But I told you, I have that figured out! I'll come to you in secret. I'll be the one breaking the law, not you! You don't even have to talk to me!", "Not until now, I didn't.", "No. It's not. You taught me how to track. Wherever you go, I can follow.", "This time... and every time. I'll be wearing this when I find you.", 'And you.', "You're... Teersa?", 'You have?', 'You... what?', 'Carja?', "But I don't know anyone here!", '... What is going on... ?', 'Are you the "old friend" Teersa told me about? I don\'t know you.', 'I remember. You tried to thank me.', "What's it going to cost?", "Thank you, Teb. I've never had anything like this before.", 'Teersa said something about envoys from another tribe?', 'Karst? What are you doing here?', 'How could I forget. And how generous of you to talk to me now.', "So... Mother's Heart thought you preferred the wilds.", "I won't hold it against you... if you give me a discount.", "I'm joking, Karst. It's good to see you.", 'Looks like it\'s on that... bald man. One of the visitors? "Unknown device detected?" What\'s that mean? He\'s wearing a Focus -- just like mine!', "You're the only other person I've ever seen wearing a Focus. Where did you get yours?", "Who says I'm like other Nora?", "What's wrong?", 'Wait.', 'His name is Olin? Who is he? And where did he get one of these?', 'I thought your friend was going to go down in a hail of fruit, but you really calmed the crowd.', 'I want to ask you something else.', 'If the Carja have such a cruel history, how did you end up serving them?', "Just how big is Meridian? What's it like?", 'I never heard anything about "Red Raids" growing up. What were those?', 'I grew up as an outcast, shunned by the tribe.', "Your sister was taken captive and sacrificed? That's terrible.", 'How did she survive?', 'So what happened? How did it all end?', 'Who are the Oseram?', 'And "Freebooters?" What are those?', 'You said the machines have been getting more dangerous every year?', "First I've heard of it.", 'Like the Sawtooth?', "So what's making it happen?", 'I want to ask about something you said before.', 'What else do you know about Olin?', "I've never seen armor like yours before.", 'With all that metal to slow you down? I doubt it.', 'I should make my way to the Blessing.', 'What are you talking about?', 'In honor of Rost, and all he did to help me get here.', "There's Olin. I haves me questions for him. Hello, Olin.", 'Why did you act so strange when we spoke earlier?', 'Stop dodging my questions.', 'What are you doing here, Olin? Why come to Nora land?', "So you're an explorer?", "I've never seen anyone else with a Focus. Where exactly did you find it?", "I found my Focus in a cave just like you're describing. A ruin of the Old Ones.", 'When we spoke earlier, you winced, then looked like you were in pain -- or frightened. Did your Focus show you something?', "You're not a very convincing liar.", "Only the ones who aren't telling the truth.", "I don't understand. We have this... device in common, but you can't wait to stop talking to me.", "I'm used to being shunned by the tribe. I thought you'd be different.", "What'd you say?", 'Oh, this is the bed-house? With you standing guard, I figured it was the latrine.', "So this is how it's going to be with you, is it?", "You can sense it. You already know you're going to lose.", "Really? Confidence is quiet. You're not.", "The look on your face when I knocked that stone out of your hand was pretty entertaining. But I suppose you leave that part of the story out when you tell it, don't you?", "All you did that day was make me stronger. Just wait. I'll show you tomorrow.", 'Oh, are you going to shut your mouth? Because that would be a surprise.', "I don't believe we've met. I'm Aloy.", "Nice to meet you, Vala. You're right. I am going to win tomorrow.", 'Okay. Thanks.', "Comforts and distractions. That's what I think.", 'Comforts are weakness.', "I've got to catch up! Faster! Come on!", 'No way but forward now.', 'Come on now! Faster! Stop dragging! Got to keep going!', "Good. I'm gaining!", "Made it. Come on now. Hurry. Keep at it... I've trained my whole life for this. They had a tribe... but I had the wilds... Precision... not enough... must be... perfect. Come on, come tins, you can make it... Can't let them beat me now!", "They can't shoot if they're dead. Keep them busy, I'll find an angle.", 'Okay, no more sneaking.', 'Vala!', 'Rost... No... No, no. I have to get out of here. I need my focus... no! (her focus is gone) Rost saved me. They must have found me before I bled out. But why is no one here? Where am I?', "My clothes - good. But where's my Focus? Ah. It's here. Okay. Wait? Am I inside the sacred mountain? But only Matriarchs are allowed inside. I don't see my bow here. Or that damaged Focus, I took of that... killer. Where are they? I'm picking up some kind of signal. The Nora didn't build this place - the Old Ones did. But why? It looks like the ruins I fell into when I was young.", 'There! With the rest of my things!', '(picking up damaged Focus) Now what can you show me?', 'You.', "(on record) Who says I'm like other Nora?", "They saw me through Olin's Focus... How's that possible?", 'Where is this from? And when? Are you my mother?', 'But why try to kill me because I look like you?', 'You brought me here?', 'To where?', 'Are you saying I was born here - inside the Mountain?', 'Why did you bring me here?', 'Is my mother here? Am I going to meet her?', 'Does my mother look like me, but with short hair?', "I'm - What?", 'What are you talking about?', 'What is this place?', 'But what does that have to do with where I was born?', 'Just-just lying there?', 'You mean I came from behind the door?', "But... this isn't a Goddess.", "It's a door. With people behind it? My mother?", "It's... just like the woman I saw... ", 'No. No! Please!', "Were you not listening? It didn't recognize me.", 'And how would I do that?', 'Yes. The killers came for me because I look like her.', 'Olin! He was one of the outsiders, the night before the Proving. The killers saw me through his eyes. He lives in Meridian... ', "I've been an outcast all my life. Why not an exile, too?", 'You said the tribe is on the brink of extinction. What happened?', 'How was the War Party defeated?', 'So the killers got away?', "Then what's your plan?", 'Even beyond the borders of the sacred land?', 'So I can go anywhere at all? No restrictions?', 'Why are the "ruins of the metal world" forbidden?', "But... I've been in a ruin. It looked a lot like the inside of All-Mother.", 'It is.', 'Have there been other Seekers?', 'Was Rost a Seeker?', 'What are you not telling me?', "What was done with Rost's body?", 'Thank you. So many have suffered. Is there anything I can do to help?', "I don't know what that means any more than you do.", 'You said the Nora sent a war party after the killers?', 'Do you know where the killers went?', 'I should be on my way.', "I will. Thank you, Teersa, for all you've done.", 'Teb?', 'What sort of rumors did you hear?', "I wasn't the only one to fight.", 'And Rost. The man who raised me. He fought to save me, and he died for it.', 'I need the gate opened.', 'I need to pass through.', "What's the danger in the Embrace? Are the killers still there?", "And these corrupted machines they're loose in the Embrace?", "Why wouldn't Resh help me?", "That I'm a motherless curse, an outcast, that sort of thing?", 'Who is Sona?', 'Was Vala her daughter?', 'So did I. What are you doing here with a bow and spear, Teb? You\'re a "Stitcher," not a Brave.', 'I should be on my way, Teb.', 'I need the gate opened.', 'I recognize you from the Proving. You saw Bast shatter my trophy, and you did nothing.', 'I nearly put an arrow through your eye.', 'I have been anointed a Seeker. So open the gate.', 'How can you be so heartless? I fought beside those children, shoulder to shoulder and back to back. I saw them fall.', 'And I am a Seeker, anointed by the High Matriarchs. So open the gate, and I will be on my way.', 'What was that?!', "Won't be long... got to get in position.", 'Here it comes!', "It's down!", 'One of this things marched with the killers at the Proving... How does it possess other machines? What is its secret? How does a machine like that take control of all those Striders?', "How did you do it? Show me. You made them obey you. But how? This. You did this with this. It's... connecting to my focus. Then - I could use this? It's worth a shot. Couple loops of wire... Looks like it'll hold. I just need to test it.", "The way it controls other machines - I think I've figured it out. But I need to test it on a machine.", "Exactly. And the Gates are where I'll be headed anyway. I need to speak to Varl.", 'But what.', 'Thank you, Teb. But I have to go now.', 'I need to test this device. See What it can do.', "Striders. I can test the Override device on them. Should go in quiet. Didn't go through all of this to wind up trampled by a frightened herd. Nice and quiet. Okay, here it goes! Come on, come on... It worked! It's not hostile... Seems almost tame. I think I could ride it! There we go. Thattaboy. That's more like it. Ya! This Strider is fast! This beats walking! I should try overriding other kinds of machines! Probably can't ride them all, but I might find a use for them!", 'Sounds of fighting just outside the gates?', 'The gates look shattered!', 'Varl I take it?', 'High Matriarch Teersa said you might know the way to Meridian.', 'No -- a traitor named Olin. The Matriachs made me a Seeker, so I could go after him.', '"If" I make it?', "Isn't that Resh's job?", 'You said the trail is dangerous What sort of dangers?', "Yes, I've seen it myself.", 'Sounds like I need to craft more arrows. You said I won the Proving. How did you know that?', "Your sister was Vala? ... I'm very sorry. I... liked her. I think we might even have become friends... If we'd had a chance.", 'You said the War Party was massacred. How?', 'You said War-Chief Sona is missing?', "You didn't volunteer?", "So there's no way to know if she's alive or dead?", 'Sounds like she sets a high standard.', 'I should be on my way.', 'Where was she last seen?', "I get it, Varl. I'll see what I can do.", "It's hard to explain. Something I... discovered.", "One of them, maybe. I didn't fight alone. You're Marea? Varl told me you'd to know the way to Meridian.", 'They can try.', "So if I clear out the corrupted machines, they'll open the border?", 'Who said I needed help?', "I'm good with my bow.", "So I'll find this Carja fort to the west? And beyond that, Meridian?", 'What forsaken village?', 'What happened to it?', 'How far has the corruption spread?', 'Do the corrupted machines have any weaknesses?', "Unless we find out what's behind it, and put a stop to it.", "Mother's Crown guards the edge of the Sacred Land, right? So do you see a lot of foreigners here?", "Sounds like a place where I could find out more about Meridian. So you're in charge of the defenses here?", 'Good luck convincing her to do that.', 'Trying to live up to glorious pasts has a way of getting people killed.', "This isn't the Proving, Marea. This is real.", 'I should be going.', "I've done what I can to cleanse this valley of Corruption... time to see if the Carja fort will let me pass over the mountains.", 'Sounds of fighting? Has something attacked the Carja fort? A Corruptor!', "It wasn't the Sun risking its ass down here.", 'So. Will you open the gate for me now?', 'West! To Meridian!', 'Okay. Thanks.', 'My whole life... all of it in the Embrace. The world just got bigger. But also more dangerous.', 'Are you all right, hunter? Were you injured when the War Party was ambushed?', "Well, whoever you are, you're hurt. What happened?", 'You got Injured at a Hunting Grounds? How?', 'Why did you say you weren\'t "anything at all?" And that I shouldn\'t talk to you?', "Things aren't exactly going your way, are they? Is there anything I can do to help?", 'I need to get going, Cren.', 'I spoke to Cren. He told me this is a Hunting Grounds, where you offer tests of skill.', 'Yes, but I would have gone even without their permission.', "You're not supposed to be here, are you?", "You think it will work, staying here without the Matriarchs' permission?", 'Tell me about the Trials.', 'What do I get for completing them?', 'What kind of tools?', 'What is the Hunters Lodge?', "There's gotta be a way to override even these things.", 'I have to go.', "That man... he doesn't look Nora.", 'Danger for you, outlander. This is Nora land.', 'Who was he?', 'Varl told me there would be bandit ambushes on the road.', 'Unless... someone does something about it?', "My Focus is picking up some kind of signal. Maybe I can scan it. Those ruins... that must be Devil's Thirst. A city of the Old Ones. Of the Metal World. That signal... where is it coming from? I have three Suns-- now they'll let me inside the Hunters Lodge. Well, let's see how that turns out. A Nora village, up on the heights... ", "This must be where the War Party got massacred. Such destruction... Maybe the War-Chief left something behind, some clue about as to where she went. Lots of Machines, all controlled by the killers. The Nora managed to take down a Corruptor. They sent a stampede of them down the slope. But not before the killers used it to send the other Machines against them. Look at this place. It's like Varl said -- another massacre.", "Just me. You're hurt. What happened?", 'Varl told me that the War-Chief tracked the killers. Did she find them?', 'So you were here when the war party was ambushed?', "Varl sent me to look for Sona. Do you know where she's now?", "Tallneck... Looks just like Rost described. Not enough handholds to climb those legs. There must be another way. Low and quiet does it. Passed the test. All right. Now I just have to reach its head. I know, I know. I wouldn't want to be poked in the head, either. So the Tallneck remembers everything along its path and sends what it sees to other machines.", "This must be the rise Sona's runner told me about. Arrow shards. Braves were crafting ammunition here. A recent kill, freshly skinned. The War-Chief stopped here. So where did she go next? That old bow has seen a lot of action. No one would have left it willingly. Sona's taking losses. They must have taken a moment to rest. Couldn't have been easy going on after the ambush. Sona and her braves can't be far. Dressings for wounds. The runner wasn't the only one who got hurt. Might be a blood trail I could follow. I should try my Focus.", 'Tracks. Boots and blood. Looks like Sona and her braves headed for that ridge. A dead Sawtooth. Maybe Sona took it out? She could be close.', "Half a heartbeat more, and I would've killed it myself. Uh, so you're War-Chief Sona? Varl asked me to find you.", 'He has -- bravely. I saw him kill a corrupted machine himself. But he worries for you.', 'Oh, you have no idea.', "I know of them! I killed one at Mother's Watch!", 'We could have more than that.', "That's Blaze. What we use to burn, they use to blast -- it's how they dug out this pit.", 'Boom.', "Whoa -- wait. Let's not rush. Give me some time to make an approach. If I end up alerting them, open fire.", "They're still looking. Can feel the corruption boiling off it! Goodbye, quiet approach.", "You're hurt. Losing blood.", 'No one doubts your determination. But you need to rest.', 'Maybe I should have a look around, see if I can figure out where the rest of the killers are.', 'Hmm. A Blaze stockpile inside their base... Sabotage that, and we win.', 'I found something. The rest of the killers are camped inside a "Ring of Metal". Any idea what that means?', "There's no time for that.", 'Sounds like a plan. See you there.', "You might take that back, when you see what I'm getting us into.", "Don't you even wonder what it used to look like, back when the Old Ones lived here?", "That's what they tell me.", 'Then we should hit those camps first. Elisabet said a new generation of humans would be spawned inside such places.', 'All-Mother mountain - it was one of them?', "The hatch wouldn't open. Something... Something about a corrupted Alpha Registry. I need to search Elisabet's office.", 'Looks like it used to hold something... some component that got removed.', 'The Alpha Registry master file!', 'Yes. No signs of corruption.', 'With this, I can restore the registry at the hatch inside All-Mother. Open it, go inside.', 'Where I was bom. Maybe... maybe who gave birth to me... ', 'You bastard.', 'Eclipse.', "See that scar on your cheek? You didn't get to finish.", 'His name was Rost, and he was a better man than you could ever hope to be!', "Some destiny. You're following orders, not some grand cosmic design. You're a puppet, with Hades yanking the strings. A pawn, pushed around by larger forces. It'd be laughable if there weren't so much killing involved. Hades is an ancient machine, not the Buried Shadow of Carja myth. It doesn't care about Meridian. It wants to kill everything and everyone - and you are its dutiful slave.", "Do you really not hear how ridiculous that sounds? You've gone from serving an insane, homicidal Sun King to an insane, homicidal machine. You're moving down in the world, not up!", 'Then open this cage and put your faith to the test. See if things work out like you expect.', "Why butcher dozens of innocents for no gain? It's a waste of effort.", "I'll never beat that thing without weapons. All my weapons are up on the platform, and there's no way out of this ring. Maybe I can use its strength against it... ", "That makes a mess! That pillar's week! Another hit and that pillar will come down! That did it! One more pillar, and that platform will come down! And my weapons with it! It's down! Hey! Guess who got her weapons back?! Now you're just a big dumb target! Come and get it! Freeze canister on its hips! Cryo arrows should set it off! That canister on its belly! Looks important! Those components on the sides of its head! They've got something to do with his Lift attacks!", 'Why leave it to THEM?! Come get me yourself!', "So you're here. Really here. You risked your life.", 'Too bad you wasted your time, then. Helis destroyed my Focus... and the Alpha Registry with it.', "You're really good at making it impossible to like you, Sylens. But I guess I need this.", "Yeah. Meet the machine that birthed me into this world. Isn't that how you put it.", 'Wait.', "How did you track my location when I wasn't wearing a Focus?", 'Since when can you override machines?', "Great. You're welcome, I guess. Helis recognized you back in the Sun Ring. You told me that you'd 'assisted' the Eclipse... not that you knew the man who killed my... who almost killed me.", "Right. I'll be on my way. To make matters worse. Helis ordered an Eclipse detachment to attack the Nora Sacred Land. The tribe's already weak. They won't stand a chance. You should come with me.", "You think of everything, don't you?", "That smell - trees on fire. The Embrace. Watchtowers, burning. But the Sentinels had time to warn the tribe... The Nora made a stand here. Anything to protect the Embrace. But the gates couldn't hold. This is Hades's future. Metal... and ash. The Embrace... it's devastated. For years this was my entire world. It can be destroyed in hours. Mother's Cradle... razed to the ground. No birdsong. I've never heard the Embrace so quiet. So... dead. Another battle... another defeat. The Eclipse smashed through. More Eclipse. It's a corrupted Thunderjaw, all right! The survivors must be holed up in the mountain! If the tunnel collapses they'll be buried - and I'll never reach the hatch.", "Varl and Sona - they're still alive!", 'Stay still!', "It's holding! No good. Finish them!", "I'm glad to see you're all right, Varl. You are all right?", 'For now. But this was just one battle, Varl. There are more to come.', 'How many survived the attack?', 'Well, this enemy may have broken through. But they never got back out. We made sure of that. Tell me about the attack. What happened?', 'So the survivors took shelter in the mountain? By law, on the matriarchs are allowed inside.', "Teersa's decision saved lives. Good for her. Common sense isn't always so common around here. Are your injuries serious?", "Don't give me a hunting song, Varl! Are you okay?", 'I need to go inside the mountain.', "I'm sure. But I didn't come here for them.", 'You will see.', 'Teb?', 'Your injuries - are they serious?', 'Guess being a Stitcher came in handy in combat, after all, hmm?', "You wouldn't believe the things I've seen, Teb.", "Um... yeah I guess you could say that. I think it'll work this time.", '(strong answer) I fought my way past an army while you cowered in this cave. You really think you can stop me?', "What would you know about what's necessary? About what it took for me to be standing here, now, on this threshold? This was my birthright. You don't get to take it from me a second time.", 'Figured I might be hearing from you.', 'I never stopped. So this is "Eleuthia." This is where I was born?', '(sighs) So these are... artificial wombs?', 'And me? So this was it.', 'But - why? These look like... cribs.', 'And those... things? The multiservitors - they took care of them?', "So this... is where they lived? It's a mess. Everything's broken, or painted on. How long did they live here?", 'They were trapped here... their whole lives.', "Looks like they didn't like this door very much.", 'So what was this place, exactly?', 'But why not?', 'APOLLO offline?', "Maybe there's a way to fix it. But it's not why I came here.", 'I will.', 'That sounds important.', 'What?', 'Does she mean - the Derangement?', 'I never had a mother.', "I'm not a person, I'm an instrument. Manufactured by a machine. Born in destruction... and fire... ", 'This is going to be... interesting.', 'She did.', 'That... I was born to lift a curse. To kill a Metal Demon.', "I don't know yet... but she told me where to go to find out.", "It was her wish. What she made me for. Yes. I will do it. I'll try, anyway.", 'No! NO! Stop this! Up! UP! First you shun me, now this?! I will NOT be worshiped! I\'m not your "Anointed!" I don\'t belong to you! There\'s a whole world beyond your borders. Whole tribes of people just as good as you, and it is all in danger! It\'s a world worth fighting for. Not just here. Everywhere.', "If you can fight, and you're willing... go to Meridian, and wait for me there.", 'More corrupted?', 'So what else is new?', "Stalkers in the open. Watchers on the other side. A killing machine that disappears into thin air. Just what the world needs. Do they think they're guarding GAIA?", "Guessing that I'm almost there!", "That better have been the biggest guard you've got, GAIA.", "GAIA's sacrifice-- it did this? Cracked the inside of the mountain like it was an egg?", "So you've been in here before.", 'You made a climbing path for me, but left an army of machines for me to deal with?', "Don't look down... Don't look down... ", 'This is exactly the kind of place I expected to find you in, Sylens.', 'You make it sound like I should apologize.', "Looks like you've spent a lot of time here.", 'In her message, GAIA said we could restore her. But after seeing the damage-how could that be?', "But... do you think it's even possible to restore GAIA?", 'I thought you might actually be here this time. Actually here.', "It's time for me to head in.", "Guess that's my way across. It's held like this for nineteen years. Right?", "Don't answer.", "Glad that's over. Not this way. Maybe further up the shaft?", "This must have been where they lived... what's left of it. Once this was al enclosed by rock and metal... ", "Elisabet's room... I know it. She didn't even get a chance to unpack.", "These are her journals. Elisabet's journals... and they're all destroyed?", 'How slow?', 'Elisabet... What is this?', "She's gone. Really gone.", 'While her people bickered, she was the one who took responsibility. The only one who could.', "That's not what I said!", "(heart answer) Can't you just for one moment, stop calculating and let yourself feel? She sacrificed herself for her friends. For the future. For life on earth. Doesn't that stir anything in you? The generosity of it?", 'You\'re wrong. Remember - she knew it wasn\'t enough for GAIA to think. She taught GAIA to feel. To care. To sacrifice. To believe in life. Enough to fight against hopelessness. If it wasn\'t for that "sentimentality," life would have ended. You and I never would have existed.', 'She said she wanted to go home. Maybe... ', "Nothing. It's time to go on. There's another section at the back of the crater--looks like it survived the blast.", "I'm on my way.", "I really don't like the direction tits going.", 'What-?', 'When I opened the hatch--the air rushed in from this side... ', 'But... the Alphas were in there!', 'He... He killed them all... ', "No. Not a void. When the hatch unsealed and scattered their ashes on the wind, it took them out among the world they made. The world we are living in... It's... It's a monument to what they died trying to accomplish.", 'Not oblivion, Sylens. Hope.', "The Master Override. It's so small... ", "That didn't sound good.", "You're-- here!", 'What?', 'Go on.', 'What--?', 'And in exchange... ?', 'Why are you telling me this now?', 'The Spire was created by GAIA... ', 'MINERVA. Its code-breaking module GAIA built Spires to transmit the codes that deactivated the Faro robots... shut down their bio matter conversion systems... HADES wants to send a new transmission! To wake the machines -- so they can devour the world all over again!', "So the Eclipse, the robots they've resurrected... they're just a means to an end. An army to capture the Spire.", 'I want you to tell me everything. HADES, the Eclipse – everything.', 'Then get started!', 'A real kindred spirit.', 'So you thought it was a titan? An old war machine?', 'What did it want to know about the Spire?', 'Enough to equip a small army.', 'And the Shadow Carja? How did they become involved?', "An opportunity? That's what it was to you?", "But HADES didn't care about Meridian. And neither did you.", 'The ability for you to spy on them.', "What made you turn on HADES? It certainly wasn't your conscience.", 'A little late.', 'So when did I come into this? Our "path together"?', "The things you've done in the pursuit of knowledge, Sylens... ? Pure recklessness.", 'Unbelievable.', "Then I just need to get close enough to HADES' skull to stab it in?", 'Oh, no problem. Sylens! Where will you go?', 'And all this?', "I have to tell Avad that the Eclipse are ready to strike. After what happened with Dervahl, I know he'll defend the city. But the Spire... ", "A threat. The Eclipse will attack soon from the west... With an army of ancient war machines - but that's not the worst of it. They'll bring a... mind with them. God, demon, machine. Whatever you want to call it. It's called Hades, and it doesn't want Meridian at all. It wants the Spire. And if it gets there... It will send out a call, waking more ancient machines. More than we could ever defeat. All will be lost. We can't let that happen.", "Meridian isn't the target, Avad. You have to defend the Spire.", 'And have the city guard fortify the westem ridge. There they can be seen to protect Meridian and the Alight, where the Spire rests.', "Then you have it... as long as you don't confuse me with her again.", "I don't know about 'everything, but I'll tell you what can.", 'For me?', "The ridge will be the front line. That's where the city guard are holding?", 'And the Spire - Erend and the Vanguard are there?', 'I will. I suppose all we can do is wait for the attack.', "She doesn't much like being called 'Anointed,' either. It means a lot to have you here, Varl.", 'So, Meridian. What do you think?', "Varl, what's wrong?", 'Is that why you came?', "I think the Goddess and I are in agreement. We're both glad you're here.", "I'm not sure. But there's going to be a lot of them, and they'll have machines. And if they get past us, it's not just Meridian that will fall. The rest of the world will go with it.", 'Thank you, Erend. Ersa would be proud.', 'War-Chief Sona. War-Chief, you, uh... you seem uncomfortable.', "I'm sorry to put you through this.", 'More of me?', 'Do all Oseram flirt at the most inopportune times?', 'Can I try one?', 'You did, Teb. But have your wounds even had time to heal?', 'It sounds impressive.', "She didn't need to. I know we can do this, Teb.", "Olin's apartment. Feels... empty. Should I sleep? Did leave anything unfinished?", "How could you sleep. Elisabet, with a weight like this pressing on you? How did you, Rost, after you lost your family? ... Sylens? Are you there? Guess I shouldn't ask ghosts for advice.", "That's not wood smoke.", 'The end. Or how it begins, anyway.', 'To the guns! To the guns! NOW!', "We're about to find out.", 'No, Rally the Vanguard and send reinforcements!', 'We need those guns!', 'Not this time.', 'Should have fought me in the Sun-Ring, then.', "Bridge can't take much more of this!", "(smart answer) You're done. Hades is next.", 'Where do you need me?', 'Here it comes! Better move!', "Let's do this.", 'Incoming! Gotta drop it and move!', 'Chance to catch a breath--and prepare.', "Well, they're still surprised.", "It's off! It's taking a shot at me!", "Don't want to be here when that hits!", "Now it's mad. Time to go! Incoming!", 'Teb... ?', 'The others are they--?', "Take care of the others, Teb. I've... got to go.", 'No Banuk... turns away... from a challenge.', "Rest now, ice hunter. It's begun! HADES is transmitting!", "If HADES has started the signal-- it must have gotten through the defenses! The Nora... Erend's Vanguard... I have to get up there. Get to keep going. Keep pushing. Knew this wouldn't be... easy. So no holding back. They're alive!", "No, the ridge fell on me. There isn't a lot of time left. I have to face HADES.", "My fight. I can't ask you to come with me.", 'I should stock up. Last chance.', "I'm gonna tie one down!", "All of you, focus on the new machines! We've got time. Okay. Still got time.", 'Take them out first!', 'Taking notice of me, huh? Help me bring it down!', "This one's persistent!", 'Time enough to beat the machines back... ', "That's it-- my way's clear!", "I'm more than a threat.", 'Elisabet Sobeck... Alpha Prime.']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['Aloy of the Nora - she who sees the unseen. Welcome. It would seem you have done me a great service. Erend, tell her what you found.', "If the body is not Ersa's, then we must assume she is still alive. And I will not abandon her.", "I can't move troops to the border without provoking the Oseram. But I could send a few Vanguardsmen - and perhaps an exceptionally gifted Nora as well? Erend, Marad - let me discuss it with her privately.", "I hate to impose further after all you've done. But if this is a matter of great importance to me.", "Without her Oseram Vanguard I would not have been able to liberate Meridian and end my father's brutal reign. Since then, it has been difficult to maintain the peace between our tribes, but Ersa has a way of making her people see reason. So you is I need her back at my side - and quickly.", "To understand Dervahl, you must first understand my father. He truly thought of himself as a Sun God. His mind was... broken. He believed that blood sacrifice would solve... well, everything. So he raided the other tribes for victims, especially the Oseram. Dervahl fought back. He crafted powerful weapons and rallied his people. My father responded with the ultimate cruelty. He captured Dervahl's wife and daughter and sacrificed them in the, Sun Ring.", 'He felt she betrayed him. She fought by his side until she realized he planned to raze Meridian and butcher its people. Then she came to me. Together, we stopped him... and liberated the city from my father. Dervahl has spent every moment since trying to get revenge, mostly on the other Oseram who fought with us. He made so many powerful enemies, I thought we had seen the last of him. I was wrong.', "What you're saying echoes reports I've received from Marad. A Shadow Carja splinter group. Corrupted machines across the land. When will this attack come, do you know?", 'Then we will do what we can to prepare, but in the meantime, Ersa is my highest priority. Please help me find her.', 'By all means.', 'They say you can see the invisible, split an arrow at fifty paces, and tame machines at a glance. How much of that is true?', 'Well, I would like to unite the tribes in harmony. But you saw how many courtiers I have to deal with first. Maybe next week.', "You don't approve? Well, I have a secret for you. Neither do I. But we must be patient. Change won't come in a single sunrise.", 'It might. Eventually. If people like you help me bring it about.', "I couldn't have liberated Meridian without the help of Ersa and her Oseram freebooters. Many of them are settled here. But the Ealdorman of the Oseram clans in the Claim have become jealous of their success. So have many Carja nobles. It's a volatile situation, especially given the fact that my father raided the Oseram for years. Ersa helps keep the peace, promising a future based on mutual gain. But some, like Dervahl, will never let go of their venom.", 'I know. Well, they say kings should never beg - but please, help me find Ersa.', "Marad, for one. Don't hesitate to ask him or Erend if you have further questions.", "If there's anything you or your clan need for her arrangements, you need but ask.", "Aloy. I'm glad you're back. I'm at a loss about Ersa. To learn she lives, then lose that hope seems cruel.", '(firmly) Our security depends on keeping the peace. If the opportunity presents itself, take him alive. Consider that a command. Aloy, a moment, please.', "When we spoke, Erend didn't wish to dwell on the... details... of Ersa's death. Understandable, of course. But now that that they've been left to my imagination, those details are all I can think about. You were there. Did she suffer?", "Is it that obvious? You're right, I'm dwelling on my pain, not just hers. And there is only one thing left that can help. Find Dervahl and bring him before me. He will answer for his crimes. Don't let me delay you any longer. Meet Erend at the warehouse.", "Aloy, to say you have my gratitude feels woefully insufficient. You saved my life. You saved Meridian. And because of you, there will be justice for Ersa's murder. We can mourn her knowing the truth, without painful uncertainty. It's hard to imagine where we'd be without you - and I don't want to try. I hope you will consider staying in Meridian.", "I suppose it's obvious how I feel... how I felt about her. She didn't just give me advice. She gave me strength. But we couldn't be together. Relations between the Carja and Oseram in Meridian were unsteady as it was. The union of the Sun-King and an Oseram warrior would have lead to open revolt in the city, and probably war with the clans.", 'Only one - Dervahl. He wanted Ersa, but she rejected him. And so jealousy became yet another of his hateful motivations.', "For now, he'll languish in one of the old cells under the Sun-Ring here in Meridian As for what happens after we negotiate his extradition to Mainspring. I don't want to think about My father was very creative when it came to inflicting suffering, but some Oseram devices surpass even his imaginings. What a waste. Dervahl is a brilliant man. I wonder what he would have accomplished if it weren't for my father's cruelty.", "I see what you're saying echoes whispers I've heard from Marad. A Shadow Carja splinter group. Corrupted machines across the land.", 'When will the attack come, do you know?', 'Then we will do what we can to prepare. Keep me informed if you learn more.', 'Itamen, my brother. Welcome home. You have nothing to fear -- you are now under the protection of the Sundom. My protection. As is your mother. She will not be harmed. You have my word, the law of the Sun. Aloy - it seems I see your influence everywhere. You have done so much for the Sundom and it will always be appreciated. You have my thanks. May you walk in the light.', 'Aloy. What brings you to Meridian?', "I'm trying to understand... but - my responsibility lies with Meridian.", "Yes. Send them to the Spire. Erend knows Aloy, he won't question it.", "Aloy, allow me to apologize for my behavior before. After everything that happened with Ersa, was... confused. If we're to fight together on the brink of life and death, I'd prefer to do so with your forgiveness.", 'Campfires, perhaps? Massing forces for the long march to the city gates?', 'Then what is it?', 'The Deathbringers you spoke of?!', 'By the Sun, do as she says!', 'Will the guns hold them back?', 'Helis?!', 'Aloy – no!', 'He will cut you down!']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['Captain Okilo. Are you trying to thank me for not resisting?', "When it came to my country's lithium, it was always a swarm that would be sent to negotiate. Metallurgic International. US Robot Command... The markings changed, but the robots were the same.", 'Yes, and I\'ve got the prosthetic limbs to show it. Still I continued to face this horror, even though the challenge was great. Cyber-warfare. I thought Zero Dawn would be a... a "Manhattan Project", to generate the deactivation codes. With the resources I had, I estimated code-breaking to be a hopeless endeavor. I almost looking forward to being proved wrong.', 'As your General Herres said. So then. You did not bring me here to commiserate. What is left?']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['By the glory of the Sun revealed! Behold! Radiant Itamen, the one true Sun King, the light in shadow, whose will us light and whose light is law!', 'By the will of Radiant Itamen does the Sun glare down mercilessly upon the traitor Uthid! To the hunter who brings his head to us shall go a bounty of 500 Shards!', "I had to come here myself! To end you suffering, Uthid-- and mine. The outlanders led us here. And now that they are dead, their price is most affordable. But enough with needles. It's time for blades. Remove them from the Sun's sight. Kill the traitor! Kill the Nora! The sun sets on your pathetic life, Uthid.", "Wherever deal you worked out with him - I'll double it! More than double it.", 'I had to-- I had to! Prune the weak, or all the Carja in Shadow are doomed!']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Nothing good - more machines all the time, and our scouts report corruption of that way, as well. So much for sealing things off. Keep to the roads, they're safe enough. Though after what you did at the gate, I'll wager you don't scare easily - it's a good quality. I could put it to use, if you don't mind a quick jaunt back east. I know it's bold of me to ask a favor after you just did one. But I can offer answers in return, if there's anything you need to know about the Sundom.", 'I sent several patrols east when we got word of corrupted machines there. All of them confirmed my fears, so I sealed the gates. But it looks like we left some men behind when they were closed. Walid, tell her what happened.', 'Never seen a Nora woman before? Have some respect. Report to her, not to me.', 'Now that the gates are open again, I can send someone after them.', "Most Nora still don't take well to the sight of Carja armor. Officially it's a risk to send patrols so close to your Sacred Land. I'd prefer not to do that again. But heading that way one big problem for you.", 'What was that, soldier?', "Daytower marks the eastern edge of culture territory - a trading post, a waystation... one with an ugly reputation among your people. During the reign of the last Sun-King, many Nora were taken captive, then you gathered here for transport to Meridian... and sacrifice. But the Sun's set on that. I was appointed by Sun-King Avad to make sure all Carja at this outpost show respect to the Nora.", "Sun-King Avad wants peace. So do the Matriarchs, I'm told. But old wounds are slow to mend, and both tribes are proud. My task is to make sure there are no further provocations from the Sundom. Especially now, after, well... While your people recover from this terrible attack, I mean.", "It's a changed place, a living city. Nothing like it was during the rule of Sun-King Jiran. Avad, our new king, has done all he can to make sure of that. Slavery has been abolished. There's a new alliance with the Oseram. And the Sun-Ring, where so many outlander were killed, is now a memorial to the fallen.", "He is the chosen of the Sun. And what the Sundom needs after ten years of war - a calming light not a scouring one. Sun- King Jiran who shed blood at any slight. For Sun-King Avad, that's the last resort. Lucky for those who slight him. Some whisper in the shadows that he's weak. No. Peace is strength, as the Sun shall show.", "Hard to believe, but it's true. Mad Sun-King Jiran raided the Oseram for years. Avad managed to get them on his side. He had help, of course. Ersa and Erend played a part - Oseram siblings, bigger than life. They gathered an army to free Meridian. I marched with them. Scaled the north cliff with my men and secured the Temple of the Sun. Sent Jiran's kestrels and priests packing. Now Oseram are a common sight in the city. And a common sound - they sure bicker a lot.", "Sun-King Avad has devoted considerable resources to making it safe. But by the Sun's witness... It's been harder to control in peace than it was during the war. The machines grow more dangerous all the time. Add to that bandits, and new reports of this corruption... We're stretched thin to protect a few outposts like this one. As for everywhere else, well travel at your own risk.", 'Twice. He was part of the royal delegation to the Nora, and they passed through on the way, then back. They brought back stories of a vicious attack on your people. My condolences, of course.', "Not exactly, but he was on his way to Meridian, I'm certain of that. Everyone goes to Meridian.", 'I would be grateful - but not as grateful as Walid. Hear that, lunkhead? You might be off the hook.']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Apocashitstorm Tour, day 4. It's hard to believe Metallurgic International used to be headquartered in this dreaded old ziggurat. Wyatt's office was on the second floor from the top. If M.Int had a policy against workplace romances, he probably wrote it."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['Stay away. No-Mother!', 'Ahh!', "Well, well - look who's come in from the wild! The motherless outcast! I see you've still got a scar from where that rock I threw hit you! Now that's a cherished memory.", "You didn't know the words to the Blessing, did you? But no one hears your prayers anyway.", 'Aw, you even try to dress like real Nora. Not that it fools anyone.', "This is how it's going to be with everyone, outcast. You belong in the wilds, not Mother's Heart And you definitely don't belong in the Proving.", "Ha! I've trained all my life for the Proving! I'm not afraid of you-- I'm not afraid of anything!", "You know, I often think of the day I gave you that scar. It's a cherished memory.", 'I branded you that day to mark your shame.', "Yeah, right! This is boring! Time for Bast to get some sleep! You'll be the one surprised tomorrow, outcast. Not me.", "She didn't win! The outcast cheated!", "I'm with you.", 'Kill the invaders!', 'Kill them!', 'Vala! No!']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["The protocols use poly phasic entangled waveforms. Quantum encryption, Black Quartz stuff, way beyond military-grade. That's what you demanded, so that's what we delivered.", 'You specifically forbade us from leaving anything resembling a back door in code. "Every protocol to Black Quartz standard." Your words. Look. If you need me to fudge some projections, it\'s nothing we haven\'t done before.', "I don't know what to tell you, Ted. You're asking the impossible.", 'On the Chariot line self-replication routines. I came here thinking this was a rendition. When your people took me, I thought, "About time." I\'ve been trying to swallow the guilt every day since... since, ah... ', "No, no - I just... really hoped Zero Dawn was a way to undo it all. My work. I'm sorry to say I was ever proud of it. But Ted could really sell a concept, and in the labs, in the... light of creation... That first test run, when you saw they understood their own structures, could rebuild themselves from memory and light... There were no limits. Oh, God, there were no limits."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["This is Charles Ronson. I'm logging this six hours after final deployment of GAIA Prime. This morning... an access port seal malfunctioned. GAIA Prime's port seals were designed to close with a seam of less than 2 millimeters. But this one closed with a 10 millimeter gap. Enough for an energy signature to bleed through. Enough for the swarm to detect this facility. Enough for GAIA to be discovered and destroyed. Enough to end the future we worked so hard to make possible. Unless the hatch servos were manually re-engaged... from the outside. I'm now switching to a recording of the event.", "It should be Lis's decision.", "Not like this. There's so much we... ", 'Lis.', 'That was the last transmission of Elisabet Sobeck. She gave everything for the hope of life on this planet. And we are all in her debt.', "You'd hate it, Lis, but I wrote you a eulogy. I had to try to express... All your... children... after all APOLLO has taught them, they'll think they know everything. But they have to understand what you did for them. How you loved the whole world, so much. With an intensity that was... dazzling. Bruising. And in the end, it killed you. Or you died for it. Different perspectives. No-one could keep up with you. Live up to you. I don't know, maybe if I hadn't taken that postdoc in Jobur... I'm glad you shot down the Lightkeeper protocol, in the end. I don't think I could've taken seeing another one of you. I mean... Elisabet Sobeck? There's only one. I miss you.", "I'm locked out of core control-- Alpha clearance overridden. What the hell is Omega clearance?"]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['... I mean, seriously, "record our thoughts for posterity"? Great idea, Director Evans. Like I haven\'t done enough for posterity already? Like I wouldn\'t be... here... like this... if not for posterity? I\'m done with posterity. Posterity can go f... ']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Not exactly. And I'm not a hunter. Or a brave. Or anything, really. You shouldn't even be talking to me.", "My name's Cren, I thought I'd have a go at the Trials at the Hunting Grounds over the rise. You know, hone my skills. It... uh... didn't go very well.", "Well, I was aiming for a canister on the back of a Grazer, and my bowstring snapped, and I tripped, and... Aw, forget it. It wasn't pretty, okay? I just wanted to train a bit. Hunting Grounds are perfect for that. They offer Trials, which are like challenges, and they give you marks if you accomplish objectives or beat certain times. The Keeper's up there on the hill, just to the north Talk to hum to do a Trial. I'm sure you'll do better than I did.", "I stole a bow, okay? And got cast out. This was before the Proving, so now I can't even fight for my tribe in its time of need. I have to live in the wilds, by myself. Which is why I wanted some training. Honestly, I'm just glad the Keeper would talk to me. I think he might be an exile or something. He doesn't seem to care about the laws of the Matriarchs.", "No, no I'll be all right. My father always said All-Mother had a plan for me. Before he got run over by a Strider, anyway.", "All right. Be careful, especially if you're heading north. And be sure to hit the Hunting Grounds if you want to train up."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Look at you, Avad - the wriggling runt of a maniac king. You robbed me of my right to kill your father, so I'll have to settle for you. I'm going to enjoy watching the Carja bum - even more because you'll be watching with me. Say goodbye to Meridian, Avad. Breathe in the stench and choke on the ashes.", "Something's wrong-- I didn't... didn't hear anything... ", 'No! It should be a firestorm, not some belch from a charcoal-burner!', "What's this? Oh. You must be the Nora who bushwhacked my camp.", "Did you now? Well, bomb or no bomb. I'm going to splatter that throne with blood - first yours, then Avad's!", "Why does Avad always have his ladies do the fighting? Can we finish this? I've got a Sun God to kill! You'll have to do better than that, red! It's not over yet, Nora. Any good Oseram tinker will tell you - always have a third plan!", 'Ah, those majestic, murderous Glinthawks! Never do the work if you can get a machine to do it for you!', "I hope you like fighting these things, because there's more on the way!", "Go ahead. I'm not afraid - except that knowing you, Erend, you'll screw it up.", "It's just like you to get someone else to do your killing.", "Come to gloat, Nora? Well, as you can see, I'm busy. I get it, you want to rub it in. Well, it's not working. Ha ha. It's funny to pester the tinker in the cage. What a laugh. You think that bit of crap on your brow makes you smart? I'll bet you couldn't have taken apart my bomb without it. Think I'm done? Think again. I've gotten out of worse scrapes. While the lunkheads in Mathspring dither over how to kill me I'll dig myself out Just you wait. When I get out of here, I'm going to plant a Thunderjaw log in your bedroll. Got to admit it burns me that a save tracked me down. Most Nora get confused by anything more than two sticks and a string. Don't you have something better to do? Like choke on a Lancehorn? You think that spear of yours is so fancy, but I could craft it blindfolded, during a quick nap. Riding machines? And supposed to be impressed? Get one to serve me lunch, then I'll take notice. You're like a burr in a boot you know that? Just... so... irritating. Hammer to Steel, hate you."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['Brave! Let us speak! The dead and wounded, all cleared away Are there no more braves or healers here?', "What didn't? It's madness out there. War-Chief Sona sent me back to report. I'm no good to her like this.", "We followed their trail, but again and again they sent corrupted machines to attack us. My wounds started to slow me down, so the War-Chief sent me back to let others know she hasn't given up the fight.", "I was. I thought after the Proving there could be no darker day, but was wrong. The War-Chief was delayed, gathering the rear-guard. Eager for revenge, the braves in the lead, fell into the trap. Dozens, lost in minutes. If Sona hadn't arrived and rallied us, no one would've survived.", "All I can tell you is where we parted - near the metal tower southeast of the rus at Devil's Thirst. Look to the rise behind it, with a lone boulder. I'll head for the Embrace and report what I know to Varl and the others. May All-Mother lend you strength - you'll need t, going alone."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Then make it quick. I'm heading in.", 'You need to stop listening to Ted and start listening to me.', "Where's your legal team, Ted?", 'All right. This promises to be interesting.', "I know you, Ted. You've screwed something up - something big - or you wouldn't have eaten the crow to get me here. So spit it out!", 'Your killer robots?', 'So shut them down.', 'Are telling me a swarm has gone rogue, Ted?', "Show me the data, then. And I'll take that lunch - alone.", 'This isn\'t a "glitch," it\'s a catastrophe.', '- and you made them capable of self-replication.', 'Not anymore. The glitch severed chain-of-command. The only nation this swarm answers to now is itself.', "Everything else is just - food. And at the rate it's replicating, Ted, it will strip the Earth bare in fifteen months. We're not talking fall of civilization, we're talking Extinction!", "It's not contained, it can't be!", 'Right. Before the truth gets out, you mean.', "I'm going to hold you to that, Ted.", 'If there were a nicer way to fix your mess, I would have proposed it.', "It's not, Ted. It may be grim, but it's our only chance. Now sign the proposal.", 'Yes, you can.', 'I am speaking to you from a VTOL en route to U.S. Robot Command! In fifteen minutes, I meet with General Herres and the rest of the Joint Chiefs!', "Now your choice is what I tell them. Sign, and I'll tell them the wealthiest corporation on Earth has guaranteed the funds necessary to build Zero Dawn exactly as I've designed it. Or don't sign- and I will make sure they and everyone else on this planet knows the real cause of the glitch.", "Look on the bright side, Ted. From here on out you get to do what you've always been good at. Footing the bill while others get their hands dirty.", "Were you not listening?! Robots can't do the fighting for you this time! When it comes to hacking this rogue swarm is an apex predator! Anything automated you throw at it, they will hijack and take over!", "I've already mailed you a list of Alpha and Beta candidates. Most are foreign nationals or subjects of corporate holdings, so extracting them... ", "Then I'll be off.", "You've heard the bad news, and it's all true. The Faro Plague is devouring the biosphere. But does that have to be the end? What if we could give life - a future? What if we could build a kind of seed, from which, on a dead planet, life could blossom anew? This is the aim - the hope - of Project: Zero Dawn: to create a super intelligent fully-automated... terraforming system - And bring life back from lifelessness. What would such a system require? At its core, it would need a true AI. Fully capable of making the trillions of decisions necessary to reconstitute the biosphere. An immortal guardian, devoted to the re-flourishing of life. We call it GAIA. Mother Nature as an AI. But that's just the core of the system. She will need to be surrounded and empowered by a comprehensive suite of Subordinate Functions. Think of them as extensions of GAIA's mind, each dedicated to a specific purpose. Now these aren't Als, but make no mistake - each presents an engineering challenge more profound... than anything the human species has ever before attempted. Hardware that preserves adengestates the billions of seeds and embryos from which life will be reborn. The construction of underground facilities to hold it all. And that's just the start. We don't have to build the entire system. The beauty of a fully automated terraforming system is that it can build itself. Now, over the days to come, you'll learn how all these Functions - all these pieces that you'll be working on - fit together. How we'll race the clock to execute our harvest initiatives, write the software, build the tech and the facilities! How we'll lock it down and seal it up before the inevitable occurs. But even more important, you'll know how it doesn't end here. How GAIA will generate these deactivation codes General Herres talked about... and build the transmission arrays to broadcast them, shutting down the Faro robots for good. How GAIA will not just build but imagine any conceivable robot it needs to do its work across centuries... from detoxifying the Earth's ravaged atmosphere and poisoned seas... to the re-greening of the Earth from cryo-preserved seed stocks... to re-wilding the Earth with animal life. And then, when all that is done, how a new generation of human beings, spawned at Cradle facilities around the globe... will partake of APOLLO: the vast archive of human knowledge and cultural achievement from which they will learn of us, our world, and most important how not to repeal our mistakes. It's not an impossible dream. It is within our grasp if we work tirelessly and stop at nothing to achieve it. We can't stop life from ending. But if you will help me help GAIA - we can give it a future. Join me, and help make that future real.", "You're a quick study, GAIA.", 'Oh? And your assessment? GAIA?', 'And yet?', "No, no, GAIA you are not. This is good. It's very good.", 'You will undergo a brief period of unconsciousness... during relocation to Prime and final instatement.', "When you're back up and running at the new site we'll bring the subordinate functions online and see where we stand.", "(sharply) I'm fine.", "But what if - ? GAIA... there's nothing left out there... you can't even survive unless you're wearing an environmental suit. There are billions dead... in fear and agony. What if... What if it was all for nothing... ?", 'You really believe that?', "Okay, everyone. I've repaired the seal. GAIA?", "Not going to happen. The swarm's too close. Really, it's all right. GAIA's complete. She'll take care of things from here on out. That's what she does.", "Guys - you know me. I'm no good at endings. At letting things end. So let's not.", 'Yeah. Take care of each other, all right?', "I'm okay with this. I want to go home. Goodbye.", 'Okay, GAIA. Sorry about that. Where was I?', "Right. Yeah... so, like I was saying, it was a children's electronics kit, but I'd hacked the wiring to an auto battery and solar PV, so the grass caught fire. And so did a tall pine that'd stood there, I don't know, maybe a hundred years.", 'Six. My mother was home, thank god, so she called the fire department and after, she took me out on the lawn and showed me the dead baby birds. Because there were nests in the pine tree.', "I'm not sure. I remember yelling that I didn't care. And that's when my mother took my face in her hands and... spoke.", 'I never had time. I guess it was for the best.', "I guess... I would have wanted her to be... curious. And willful - unstoppable, even... but with enough compassion to heal the world... just a little bit. Anyway that's all live got for now, GAIA. Time to tuck in.", "Thank you. I'll catch you tomorrow."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ['But the Kestrels!']

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["And maybe that's all I need, you know? That moment the door opened and you were standing there, wearing that retro-weave dress, and the way you smiled... I had to look away or you were going to see. On my face. What had just... blossomed inside me, you know? Ha, it was just an instant, but I knew. I knew we'd be forever."]

Title: Horizon Zero Dawn
Dialogues: ["Hey hey hold your fruit! Nora faithful - hold your fruit! I'm Oseram, not Carja, so I'll put it to you straight: the 13th Sun King was murderous bing! He was! A tyrant and a monster! Raided my tribe for blood sacrifice, just like yours! My own sister was taken! I hated he Carja! But the 13th King is dead two years now, and who killed him? The 14th! Not because he lusted for power, but because someone had to put an end to his father's atrocities! The message this poor priest means to read is an apology. Straight from the lips of the 14th king. So please, can't you lend him your ears?", 'Olin! You making friends with locals, are we?', "Whoa. I guess he's more hung over than I thought. Hey, you've got the same trinket that Olin has on his head. Since when did those become fashionable?", "He's just a scrounger with friends in high places. He spends half his time digging for artifacts, the other half drinking or dicing. As for the trinket, I guess he dug it up somewhere. Just a weird old jewel he sticks on his face. No offense. Looks great on you.", "Thanks. I wasn't sure I could do it. The Nora are still pissed with the Carja about the Red Raids, and who can blame them?", "If you want. But I'll also be around after that Blessing thing, if that'd be a better time to talk.", "The last king and his men were butchers. But the new king wants peace. There's nothing cruel about that. Besides, the Carja don't just fight. They build. Take Meridian. Next to it, everything else is just a bunch of sticks and stones.", 'Where do I even start? My tribesmen are masters of the forge, the best tinkers in the world, but when it comes to building... roads, and buildings tall as mountains. The Carja have us beat. The city soars over a canyon, with more bridges than the Nora have. And across the valley stands the Spire, like a blade thrust into the sky, reﬂecting the sun. You really owe it to yourself to see it. So consider that a challenge. Or an invitation.', "Your tribe was at war, and you didn't even know? Were you kept hidden away? Did you have overprotective parents or something?", "Oh. Yeah, I've heard the Nora do that. Seems cruel if you ask me. But even an outcast knows about The Derangement of the Machines, right? How they get deadlier every year? Well, the Mad Sun-King figured if he spilled enough blood to the Sun God, it would calm the Machines. Didn't work. But for years he raided the tribes and took captives for sacrifice, my sister among them. The Nora put up a good fight, but... lives were lost.", "Ha! Captive, yes, sacrificed, no. Takes more than a few Carja to finish Ersa. She got away, and now she's my captain - Captain of the entire Vanguard, favored by the Sun-King himself.", "Oh, it's a story all right, but it takes a while to tell. Maybe another time, over a drink or three? Or just come to Meridian and meet her yourself. I think you'd like each other. You're both rather, ah... direct.", "The Mad King's own son united Carja rebels with Oseram Freebooters. Together we did the impossible: took back Meridian and killed the crazy old king. So now the son sits on the throne, and it's a big improvement Under Avad, there's no more sacrifices, no more slavery. People from all tribes are welcome in Meridian now, even Nora exiles. You really should come visit.", "That's my tribe, far to the northwest. We're good at three things: Arguing, working steel, and brewing.", "I guess you could say we were mercenaries - warriors for pay. Except a lot more loyal than that makes us sound. Avad couldn't have taken down his father without our metal and muscle. And now some of us serve proudly as his personal Vanguard.", "Yeah. I don't have to tell you that, right?", "Oh. Sorry. I just... assumed everyone knew. The way I hear it, fifteen, twenty years ago, the machines weren't always pissed off like they are now. When a hunter came at them, they'd spook and run. So it was hard to take them down, but not dangerous -- so long as you were smart enough to jump out of the way. But then The Derangement starts up, and everything changes. Now, when a hunter fires a shot, the machines snarl and charge right at him major risk, A few more years pass, and they start attacking people on sight. Going anywhere becomes a And if that wasn't bad enough, entirely new kinds of machines start showing up. Bigger, meaner -- and heavily armed.", 'Yeah, ten years ago, that one. But every couple years or so, something worse comes along. Believe me.', "No one knows. And the machines, they aren't telling.", 'Ask away.', "Is he really that interesting? I'm starting to get jealous. Well, he scours the wilds for ruins, digs up stuff, and sells it to nobles. When he's not scrounging, he's scouting. Exactly the skills you want the man guiding your expedition to have. I've known him a few years. He's a loyal companion, cares for his family, holds his drink well enough. I like him. But besides that, not much to tell.", "You've never seen Vanguard steel? Well, let me introduce you. Ring locked. Impact protected. Sturdy enough to choke a Sawtooth. Has to be. The Vanguard are the Sun-King's best, life-takers and Machine-breakers to a one. Might even give a Nora Warmaid like you more trouble than she can handle.", "Yeah, hard to say. From where I'm standing, looks like a pretty even match.", "Yeah. Look, maybe I shouldn't say this, but it's obvious that you don't belong in this... backwater. I mean, you're smart, you're obviously capable, and well, I mean, look at you... ", "You know what. If you ever visit Meridian, look me up. I'll show you around, make introductions. It'd be a whole new life, if you want it. Anyway, I have to go to that Blessing thing, too. So... see you around, maybe?", "Aloy?! You're alive! I thought you were dead! Make way, make way! All the way to Meridian just to see me?!", "Ah, not really. A little. So you're alive! This is we shout celebrate! Drinks on me!", 'Over there.', 'Of course I approve! From now on she may come and go from this city as she pleases!', 'There. Alone, as you asked. What did you want to tell me?', "Special to me. Heh! Special to everyone! She always knew what to do. Bossed everyone around - she kept me in line. Now I'm supposed to fill her shoes. And instead, here I am, stumbling around in them.", "Not at the rate I've been drinking.", "I know, you're right. I should expect more of myself. She always did.", "We were in the village when we heard explosions, up on the mountain. Some of your braves came back, said most of the contestants were dead. I've never heard such a wail of grief as the sound that rose up from your people. How did you survive?", 'Targeted? What do you mean?', "What are you talking about? That doesn't make sense.", "But he's a friend!", 'But... I... this... ', "He's not here. He went scrounging for scrap and relics days ago. Could be anywhere.", 'A house - here in Meridian.', "I guess. As long as I'm there to witness the search... ", 'Okay, okay. Come on.', "I don't. I just drink.", "One more word, you scorched-out slag, and I'll throw you in jail myself! Get out of here, or I'll give you all a kick in the ass!", 'Not now.', 'Hngh!', 'Here we are. Try not to break anything. Uh, other than the door.', "It pays to have connections in the Sun King's court.", 'Hey how did that get here?', "Without a key, you won't. That's a Vault Hatch of Oseram make! Nothing gets through.", "I don't think you're getting through that hatch.", "I'm sober enough, all right? I don't need another lecture!", "I don't want to talk about that. We're here because of what you said about Olin, so do what you need to do.", 'No. Closest I got was the doorstep, to help him home after a nightout. We drank a river that night, but I hold it well. Usually.', "No. He served the court as a scout sometimes, and sold ancient trinkets to nobles. But he never had an audience with the king. If you're right and Olin's into something dark, Sun-King Avad has nothing to do with it. I'd stake my life on that.", "That's what we came for.", "I did say not to break anything, didn't I?
